name: integrisea
description: IntegriSea — gestion de l'intégrité des actifs offshore (AIMS). Backend Express/MySQL, frontend Vue 3, moteur de calcul isolé.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix ./backend && npm install --prefix ./frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix ./backend" "npm run dev --prefix ./frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm install --prefix ./backend && npm run start --prefix ./backend" "npm install --prefix ./frontend && npm run dev --prefix ./frontend"
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:prod --prefix ./backend" "npm run dev:prod --prefix ./frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix ./packages/engine && npm run test --prefix ./backend
